meanings: 自认为正当的，义正词严的

examples.en: He considered himself to be holy and righteous in all his ways.
examples.zh: 他认为自己的一切行为都圣洁而正直。

examples.en: Police believe the victim was smothered with a pillow.
examples.zh: 警方认为受害者是被人用枕头闷死的。

examples.en: She smothered him with kisses.
examples.zh: 她不停地亲吻他。

examples.en: The voices of the opposition were effectively smothered.
examples.zh: 反对派的声音被有效地压制了。

examples.en: Some claim that leadership is an inborn trait, whereas others argue that it can be learned, practised and developed.
examples.zh: 有人声称领导力是与生俱来的特质，另一些人则认为它可以通过学习、练习和培养而获得。

examples.en: They were living in dire poverty.
examples.zh: 他们生活在极度贫困之中。

examples.en: The acting was dire.
examples.zh: 表演糟透了。

examples.en: She found the question highly impertinent.
examples.zh: 她觉得这个问题十分唐突。

examples.en: She tweaked his ear playfully.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑地拧了拧他的耳朵。

examples.en: I think you'll have to tweak these figures a little before you show them to the boss.
examples.zh: 我认为你得把这些数字稍作调整，再给老板看。

examples.en: He gave my ear a tweak.
examples.zh: 他拧了一下我的耳朵。

examples.en: With a few tweaks this venue will be perfect.
examples.zh: 稍作调整，这个场地就会很完美。

meanings: 缺乏经验或判断力，轻信

examples.en: They laughed at the naivety of his suggestion.
examples.zh: 他们嘲笑他的建议太过天真。

examples.en: She has lost none of her naivety.
examples.zh: 她丝毫没有失去那份天真质朴。

examples.en: Medical techniques are becoming more sophisticated all the time.
examples.zh: 医疗技术一直在变得更加精密先进。

examples.en: Mark is a smart and sophisticated young man.
examples.zh: 马克是个聪明而老练的年轻人。

examples.en: I was grateful for your timely intervention.
examples.zh: 我很感激你及时介入。

examples.en: ‘Don't you care what I do?’ he asked, but it was a rhetorical question.
examples.zh: “你不在乎我做什么吗？”他问道，但这只是一个反问句。

examples.en: For instance, the rhetorical device used in paragraph 1 contains frequent errors that render it ineffective.
examples.zh: 例如，第 1 段所用的修辞手法存在多处错误，因而未能发挥作用。

source.locator: PDF 第 33 页（印刷页 33），3 分范文的官方点评，第 2 段；这是阅卷点评而非学生原作

meanings: 简明扼要的，言简意赅的

examples.en: Keep your answers as succinct as possible.
examples.zh: 回答请尽量简明扼要。

examples.en: We were in grave danger.
examples.zh: 我们当时处于极大的危险之中。

examples.en: He looked very grave as he entered the room.
examples.zh: 他走进房间时神情十分严肃。

meanings: 重音符号（如 è 中的符号）

examples.en: We visited Grandma's grave.
examples.zh: 我们去看了奶奶的坟墓。

examples.en: You shouldn't exercise on a full stomach.
examples.zh: 吃饱了不应该运动。

examples.en: The attacker kicked him in the stomach.
examples.zh: 袭击者踢了他的腹部。

examples.en: I can't stomach violent films.
examples.zh: 我受不了暴力电影。

examples.en: She couldn't stomach any breakfast.
examples.zh: 她一点早餐也吃不下。

meanings: 把成果或遗产传给后人

examples.en: He bequeathed his daughter his entire estate.
examples.zh: 他把全部遗产留给了女儿。

examples.en: The previous government had bequeathed a legacy of problems.
examples.zh: 前一届政府留下了一连串问题。

examples.en: My request was granted.
examples.zh: 我的请求得到了批准。

examples.en: She's a smart woman, I grant you, but she's no genius.
examples.zh: 我承认她是个聪明的女人，但她并不是天才。

examples.en: There is a lot of competition for research grants.
examples.zh: 研究经费的申请竞争十分激烈。

meanings: 使泄气，削弱自信或重要性

examples.en: All the criticism had left her feeling totally deflated.
examples.zh: 这一连串批评使她感到彻底泄了气。

examples.en: Financial problems are plaguing the company.
examples.zh: 财务问题一直困扰着这家公司。

examples.en: Rock stars have to get used to being plagued by autograph hunters.
examples.zh: 摇滚明星必须习惯被索要签名的人纠缠。

meanings: 华而不实的，俗丽而无价值的
闪烁其词，支吾搪塞以隐瞒真相

examples.en: Stop prevaricating and come to the point.
examples.zh: 别再闪烁其词了，说重点吧。

examples.en: This increase in funding suggests a belated acknowledgement of the project’s value.
examples.zh: 这次增加拨款表明，人们终于承认了这个项目的价值，尽管为时已晚。

examples.en: Her silence infuriated him even more.
examples.zh: 她的沉默让他更加愤怒。

meanings: 自以为道德高尚的，自以为是的

examples.en: He was in one of his self-righteous moods.
examples.zh: 他又处于那种自以为是的情绪之中。

examples.en: Her life hitherto had been devoid of adventure.
examples.zh: 她此前的生活一直毫无冒险经历。

examples.en: There have been calls for draconian measures against drug-related crime.
examples.zh: 有人呼吁采取极其严厉的措施打击涉毒犯罪。

examples.en: He's deluding himself if he thinks it's going to be easy.
examples.zh: 如果他以为这会很容易，那就是在自欺。

meanings: 令人心碎的，令人悲痛的

examples.en: They spent the evening quaffing champagne.
examples.zh: 他们整个晚上都在畅饮香槟。

examples.en: She woke up with a terrible hangover.
examples.zh: 她醒来时宿醉得很厉害。

meanings: 后代，子女；动植物的后代

examples.en: He was surrounded by his numerous progeny.
examples.zh: 他身边围着众多子孙。

examples.en: The equipment was funded by friends and benefactors of the hospital.
examples.zh: 这些设备由医院的友人和捐助者出资购置。

examples.en: Deer are naturally timid creatures.
examples.zh: 鹿天生胆小。

examples.en: She persevered with her violin lessons.
examples.zh: 她坚持上小提琴课。

examples.en: She seemed embarrassed for a moment but quickly recovered her poise.
examples.zh: 她似乎尴尬了一会儿，但很快恢复了镇定。

meanings: 保持平衡，使稳稳停在某处

examples.en: The hawk poised in mid-air ready to swoop.
examples.zh: 鹰在半空中稳住身形，准备俯冲。

examples.en: The waters in these three rivers irrigate the plains of Punjab.
examples.zh: 这三条河的水灌溉着旁遮普平原。

examples.en: Implicit in his speech was the assumption that they were guilty.
examples.zh: 他的讲话暗含着他们有罪这一假定。

examples.en: She had the implicit trust of her staff.
examples.zh: 她得到了员工们的完全信任。

examples.en: Suddenly the boat tilted to one side.
examples.zh: 船突然向一侧倾斜。

examples.en: Popular opinion has tilted in favour of the socialists.
examples.zh: 民意已经转向支持社会主义者。

examples.en: The table is at a slight tilt.
examples.zh: 桌子略有倾斜。

examples.en: She aims to have a tilt at the world championship next year.
examples.zh: 她打算在明年向世界冠军发起冲击。

examples.en: The prosecuting attorney began with a short opening statement.
examples.zh: 公诉律师先作了简短的开场陈述。

examples.en: She was made her father's attorney when he became ill.
examples.zh: 父亲生病后，她被指定为他的代理人。

meanings: 难以理解的，无法理解的

examples.en: He found his son's actions totally incomprehensible.
examples.zh: 他觉得儿子的行为完全无法理解。

examples.en: He was silenced by her stinging rebuke.
examples.zh: 她尖锐的斥责使他沉默了。

examples.en: The company was publicly rebuked for having neglected safety procedures.
examples.zh: 这家公司因忽视安全程序而受到公开谴责。

meanings: 卑躬屈膝的，毫无自尊的

examples.en: Her footsteps echoed in the empty room.
examples.zh: 她的脚步声在空房间里回响。

examples.en: This is a view echoed by many on the right of the party.
examples.zh: 党内许多右翼人士也持有这一观点。

examples.en: ‘He's gone!’ Viv echoed.
examples.zh: “他走了！”维夫重复道。

meanings: 类似之处，令人联想的痕迹

examples.en: The hills sent back a faint echo.
examples.zh: 群山传回一阵微弱的回声。

examples.en: Yesterday's crash has grim echoes of previous disasters.
examples.zh: 昨天的撞车事故令人不安地想起了以前的灾难。

examples.en: I’m not prepared to toady to him just to save my job.
examples.zh: 我不准备仅仅为了保住工作就去巴结他。

examples.en: He promised to avenge his father's murder.
examples.zh: 他承诺要为父亲被杀一事报仇。

examples.en: Their doubts were redoubled by this news.
examples.zh: 这则消息使他们的疑虑加倍了。

examples.en: She's looking for some kind of absolution for her crimes.
examples.zh: 她在寻求某种方式来免除自己的罪责。

examples.en: He was granted absolution by the priest.
examples.zh: 神父赦免了他的罪。

meanings: （学术期刊名称中的）年鉴，纪事

examples.en: His deeds went down in the annals of British history.
examples.zh: 他的事迹载入了英国史册。

examples.en: Pour the chocolate into a heart-shaped mold.
examples.zh: 把巧克力倒入心形模具。

examples.en: He is cast in a different mold from his predecessor.
examples.zh: 他与前任属于不同类型的人。

examples.en: There's mold on the cheese.
examples.zh: 奶酪上长霉了。

meanings: 影响（性格或观念）的形成

examples.en: First, mold the clay into the desired shape.
examples.zh: 先把黏土塑成所需的形状。

examples.en: The experience had molded and coloured her whole life.
examples.zh: 这段经历塑造了她的一生，并始终影响着她。

examples.en: The fabric molds to the body.
examples.zh: 这种面料贴合身体的轮廓。

examples.en: Bulky items will be collected separately.
examples.zh: 大件物品将另行收取。

examples.en: The bulky figure of Inspector Jones appeared at the door.
examples.zh: 琼斯警官高大粗壮的身影出现在门口。

meanings: 因大笑或强烈情绪而身体抖动

examples.en: His whole body convulsed.
examples.zh: 他全身抽搐。

examples.en: She rocked back and forth, convulsed with helpless laughter.
examples.zh: 她笑得无法控制，身体前后摇晃。

examples.en: We're all waiting for the zombie apocalypse.
examples.zh: 我们都在等待僵尸末日的到来。

examples.en: Development of the second point is hindered by a lack of specificity and organization.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏具体细节和条理，第二个论点的展开受到了妨碍。

source.locator: PDF 第 8 页（印刷页 8），Rater Commentary for Essay Response — Score 3，第 2 段首句

examples.en: They bungled the job.
examples.zh: 他们把工作搞砸了。

meanings: 因处理不当造成的失误

examples.en: Their pay was late because of a computer bungle.
examples.zh: 由于电脑处理失误，他们的工资迟发了。

meanings: 不肯让步的，冷酷无情的

examples.en: The heat was unrelenting.
examples.zh: 酷热持续不退。

examples.en: She is one of the president's most unrelenting critics.
examples.zh: 她是对总统批评最不留情的人之一。

examples.en: There was a general disinclination to return to the office after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，大家普遍不愿意回办公室。

examples.en: He is a slightly comical figure.
examples.zh: 他是个有点滑稽的人物。

examples.en: His clothes were grimy and bloodstained.
examples.zh: 他的衣服满是污垢和血迹。

examples.en: She looked grim.
examples.zh: 她神情严肃。

examples.en: The outlook is pretty grim.
examples.zh: 前景十分黯淡。

examples.en: Their performance was fairly grim, I'm afraid!
examples.zh: 恐怕他们的表现相当糟糕！

examples.en: I crept up the stairs, trying not to wake my parents.
examples.zh: 我蹑手蹑脚地上楼，尽量不吵醒父母。

examples.en: He's always creeping to the boss.
examples.zh: 他总是在巴结老板。

meanings: 讨厌的人，令人不舒服的人

examples.en: He's a nasty little creep!
examples.zh: 他是个讨厌的家伙！

meanings: （组织等伸出的）影响力，势力范围

examples.en: The tentacles of satellite television are spreading even wider.
examples.zh: 卫星电视的影响力正在伸向更广的范围。

examples.en: We made a tentative arrangement to meet on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们暂定星期五见面。

examples.en: Her English is correct but tentative.
examples.zh: 她的英语说得正确，但不够自信。
